snippet.title: Warframe - Official Jade: Shadows Constellations Gameplay Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Jade: Shadows Constellations Gameplay Launch Trailer for Warframe, the hit third-person action co-op shooter developed by Digital Extremes. Players can now enjoy a new cinematic quest that picks up where the hit Jade Shadows update left off in 2024. The latest update also brings Styanax Prime Access and Dante Tytonis, along with new Incarnons, Signas, Operator/Drifter hairstyles, Arcanes, Augments, and Atragraphs. Jade: Shadows Constellations for Warframe is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, iOS, and Android.
